description:
Check a company's insolvency notices and state: France from BODACC (safeguard, reorganisation, liquidation, plans, closures), Spain from BORME insolvency acts.
Use it for credit or supplier checks. Don't use it for sanctions: call screen_company.
Inputs: country and identifier, as lookup_company (e.g. 'FR', '441639465').
Returns: state (in_procedure, under_plan, closed, notice_found, none_found, not_covered), procedure, dates, notices with official citations, covered_since.
Limits: 1 unit. No notice outside the loaded years is not proof of no procedure. Read-only.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
country.title: Country

identifier.description: Official ID, as lookup_company: FR SIREN (9 digits), SIRET or VAT; ES Registro Mercantil sheet, e.g. VI-23266. GB: Companies House company number, e.g. 00445790.
identifier.title: Identifier

name: check_insolvency
title: Insolvency notices and state of a company
